en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.946 - It is narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that He said:
"Whoever recites the Tasbih of Sayyida Fatimah Al-Zahra {S.A} after the obligatory prayer before moving their legs (changing their position) will have their sins forgiven by Allah (swt)."
